user.title: Household Tasks
user.description: Enter the household members who'll be assigning tasks to themselves, separated by commas (e.g. "Alex, Sam"). You can leave this blank and add people later. These names are stored only in your Home Assistant configuration, never shared anywhere else.

abort.already_configured: Household Tasks is already set up.

init.title: Household Tasks
init.description: Add, rename, or remove household members, separated by commas. Renaming someone here keeps their existing tasks and sensor — removing someone doesn't delete their past tasks, but new counts will show them as unclaimed.
